result.instructions: Tools for Feed API, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our wholesale products are low on stock?"; "Show the orders placed this week and their current status."; "Find the order I placed with reference ORDER-1042 and list its shipments.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Feed API data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run feedapi_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run feedapi_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run feedapi_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. feedapi_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: feedapi_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List active products in your Feed API catalogue, with variants, stock quantities and computed reseller prices. Use updated_since for an incremental sync. Feed API: GET /v1/products.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date/time. Only products updated at or after this time.

tools.name: feedapi_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product with its images, category, supplier and all variants. Feed API: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: feedapi_list_product_variants
tools.title: List product variants
tools.description: List the active variants of one product with current stock_qty and computed_price. Good for a stock or price refresh. Feed API: GET /v1/products/{id}/variants.

tools.name: feedapi_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers trading on Feed API. can_accept_orders shows whether a supplier can take orders now. Feed API: GET /v1/suppliers.

tools.name: feedapi_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier's contact and country details. Feed API: GET /v1/suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: feedapi_list_inventory_movements
tools.title: List stock movements
tools.description: List stock changes for your catalogue (order_placed, supplier_edit, return_restocked and so on), 100 rows per page. Use since for incremental polling. Feed API: GET /v1/inventory/movements.

product_id.description: Only movements for variants of this product (UUID).

variant_id.description: Only movements for this one variant.

since.description: ISO 8601 date/time. Only movements at or after this time.

tools.name: feedapi_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List your orders, newest filters first, with optional status, supplier and date filters. external_ref finds the order you created with that reference. Feed API: GET /v1/orders.

from_date.description: ISO 8601 date. Orders created on or after this date.

to_date.description: ISO 8601 date. Orders created on or before this date.

external_ref.description: Exact match on the reference you gave the order.

tools.name: feedapi_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order with its line items, shipping address, tracking and supplier. reseller_* fields are the amounts charged; reseller_reference_* fields are your own selling-price snapshot. Feed API: GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: feedapi_list_order_shipments
tools.title: List order shipments
tools.description: List the shipments (tracking details) of one order. Feed API: GET /v1/orders/{id}/shipments.

tools.name: feedapi_list_order_status_history
tools.title: List order status history
tools.description: List the status changes of one order, in time order. Feed API: GET /v1/orders/{id}/status-history.

tools.name: feedapi_list_order_returns
tools.title: List order returns
tools.description: List the return requests raised on one order. Feed API: GET /v1/orders/{id}/returns.

tools.name: feedapi_list_order_cancellations
tools.title: List item cancellations
tools.description: List the item-level cancellations of one order (an order can be partly cancelled and still stand). Feed API: GET /v1/orders/{id}/cancellations.
